Class TuiRenderer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.view.tui.TuiRenderer
All Implemented Interfaces:
UiRenderer
public class TuiRenderer extends Object implements UiRenderer
TuiRenderer is an implementation of the UiRenderer interface that provides a Text-based User Interface (TUI) for the game. It handles displaying game elements, processing user input, and updating the console based on game state changes. This class follows the Singleton design pattern.

    • runUi

      public void runUi(VirtualView client, VirtualServer server, ClientModel clientModel)
      Starts and runs the TUI. It initializes the CommandParser in a new thread to continuously read and handle user input from the console.
      Specified by:
      runUi in interface UiRenderer
      Parameters:
      client - The virtual view representing the client's connection to the server.
      server - The virtual server instance.
      clientModel - The client-side model containing the current state of the game for this client.

    • setUUID

      public void setUUID(UUID clientId) throws InterruptedException
      Sets the unique client ID (UUID) for the CommandParser. It waits until the parser is initialized before setting the ID to avoid NullPointerExceptions.
      Specified by:
      setUUID in interface UiRenderer
      Parameters:
      clientId - The UUID to be set for this client.
      Throws:
      InterruptedException - if the current thread is interrupted while waiting for the parser to be initialized.
